title: dissmapr: A Novel Framework for Compositional Dissimilarity and Biodiversity Turnover Analysis
description: dissmapr provides a reproducible, end-to-end workflow for computing and mapping compositional dissimilarity and biodiversity turnover across large spatial scales. Core features include occurrence-data retrieval, environmental-data extraction, flexible grid generation, order-wise dissimilarity computation (zeta diversity and multi-site generalised dissimilarity modelling) and bioregional mapping.
